thread:
Ava L: brief follow-up on residency tiering experiment. proposal: classify tenants as strict|tiered|best-effort at provisioning. routing behavior differs per tier. we need to iron out handoff UX and operator controls.
Marcus Y: agreed. strict = reject non-resident writes (409). tiered = try client hint -> fallback to transfer handshake. best-effort = accept locally + async resident confirmation (shadow-apply).
Keiko H: ops concerns: best-effort will complicate billing and audits. recommend we gate best-effort behind explicit customer opt-in and record consent in tenant metadata. emit resident_consent_granted event.
Ravi K: legal agrees with recording consent. also require signed handoff tokens for tiered transfers so we have audit proof of resident approval. token should include tenant_id, region, timestamp, and signature.
Marcus Y: implementation notes: add header X-Residence-Policy and X-SDK-Capabilities so proxies can short-circuit. server will return 409 + handoff_token for tiered when resident check fails. client retries with token to complete transfer.
Keiko H: operator safety: add per-tenant transfer_quota (default 30/min) and circuit-breaker: if transfer_failure_rate > 10% over 5m AND transfer_count > 50, auto-quarantine tenant to read-only. notify #customer-success and create incident channel.
Ava L: metrics to add: transfer_attempts_total, transfer_failures_total, provisional_writes_total, provisional_committed_ratio, tenant_quarantine_count. dashboards and alerts owned by ops.
Marcus Y: rollout plan: canary 2 weeks on 5% of new tenants with low-risk tag. toggles: ENABLE_TIERED=true, ENABLE_BEST_EFFORT=false initially. run synthetic traces for cross-region latency.
Keiko H: runbook: steps to flip toggles, inspect provisional queue, force-clear a tenant (manual revoke), and escalate to legal for residency rejections. include automation to auto-clear quarantine after 72h unless manually reviewed.
Ravi K: action items: Marcus implement handoff token flow + API docs (owner Marcus), Keiko add quotas/alerts and runbook (owner Keiko), Ava update tenant provisioning UI + consent capture (owner Ava). ops-bot: create JIRA tasks labeled rfc-residency, multi-region, and tag oncall.
ops-bot: reminder: create tasks with labels rfc-residency, multi-region, tenant-quarantine.
Ava L: thanks all, leaving thread open for any further edge cases. tag @Marcus and @Keiko for sync. :thumbsup:
